venture.name: Smart Closet / AI Outfit Assistant
venture.name_status: Working concept label from supplied workspace; final brand not specified
venture.concept: Camera-based wardrobe inventory connected to an app that recommends outfits using style, weather, schedule and available clothing.
venture.primary_product: Proposed camera system plus companion mobile app
venture.target_customers: Ages approximately 16-35, especially busy college students and young professionals; initially fashion- and technology-interested middle- to higher-income users of all genders.
venture.value_proposition: Save time choosing outfits, build confidence and get more use from existing clothes; distinguish clean and available items from laundry.
venture.geographic_market: Proposed United States launch, urban and suburban areas with seasonal weather; later international expansion is an aspiration.
venture.distribution_assumption: Planning hypothesis only: direct online camera-kit sales and mobile app stores; the workspace does not specify channels.
venture.features_note: Manual correction is a proposed improvement in the supplied workspace, not a validated capability.
venture.mission_statement: To make getting dressed effortless through personalized technology that saves time, builds confidence, and maximizes every wardrobe.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.status: Preliminary concept-test hypotheses, not optimal prices
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.camera_kit_basis: Exploratory test range only, not a competitor-derived hardware valuation. Assumes one retrofit kit, basic self-installation and 12 months of app access; scope not defined by venture source.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.rationale: Acloset Premium and Cladwell Your Stylist provide the closest paid AI benchmarks at $9.99 monthly. Test software near or below these, with a hardware premium conditional on proven setup and availability-tracking value.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.positioning: Premium total system versus free and low-cost apps; software near or below selected paid AI alternatives.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.decision_gate: Do not set a selling price until cost, margin, demand and willingness-to-pay tests support the offer.

research_limitations: App substitutes do not establish a market price for the proposed camera system. Camera accuracy, installation, hardware scope and costs remain unknown.
US public list prices checked on October 27, 2026; no paid checkout or account-specific offer was tested. Platform, tax, region and eligibility may change the amount paid.
Verified means a price was observed on an official page or authorized marketplace, not that performance, customer outcomes or every entitlement was independently tested.
Regular and promotional price fields remain null because a distinct current regular-versus-promotional offer was not established. Annual savings are billing comparisons, not sale claims.
Acloset current paid item limits and bean usage; Whering credit action conversion, expiry and Outfit Maker duration; and some trial terms are not established.
Whering Supporter Club is closed to new members according to S7; its legacy App Store SKUs are excluded from current offers and statistics.
Drobes S15 advertises a waitlist and beta invitations, not an established retail offer; excluded from the five operating app competitors. This search is not proof that no hardware competitor exists.
Target segments and budget/mid-market/premium labels are analyst interpretations. Vendor feature claims were not product-tested.
Prior review and simulated focus-group work in the venture workspace is background only; it is not new willingness-to-pay evidence.
Averages describe selected observations, not a representative market sample; tiers and capabilities differ. Do not aggregate all offers into one average.
Distribution is unspecified in the source workspace. Direct online hardware sales and app stores are planning assumptions only.

excluded_offers.reason: Closed to new members per S7; App Store listings do not establish new-customer availability.
S15 does not establish a current retail price or general purchase availability.

missing_value_policy: null means unknown or not separately established; zero means verified free access
classification_policy: All five are indirect substitutes for a camera system and direct functional rivals to the software component.
